title: release-cutover-checklist-daily-scratchpad-2026-03-20-zoe
content:
TODAY — release cutover scratchpad (Zoe)
Date: 2026-03-20

Top-level plan (quick):
- 09:00 UTC: Freeze merges to main, start final CI pass (build + smoke tests).
- 10:00 UTC: Coordinate DB migration window (15m).
- 10:20 UTC: Deploy canary to eu-west-1 (10% traffic).
- 10:40 UTC: If canary healthy, roll to 50% and start increase to 100% by 11:10.
- 11:30 UTC: Post-cutover validation, run smoke+integration suite, sanity checks.

Pre-cutover checklist (before 09:00 UTC)
- [x] Finalize release notes blurb (Aisha) — sent draft to #release-comm.
- [x] Ensure all blocking PRs merged or marked for backport (see JIRA-REL-7891).
- [x] QA smoke signoff from Marcus (done 2026-03-19 17:10 PT).
- [ ] Confirm alert runbooks are up-to-date (quick skim) — TODO: Jordan to confirm.
- [x] Create rollback branch (release/v2026.03.20-rollback) and tag.
- [ ] Notify SRE on-call and paging policy (pinged @oncall but need acknowledgement).

Deployment steps (notes to self)
- Lock repo: set branch protection -> restrict merges. Double-check CI queue not saturated.
- Kick off release pipeline: pipeline/release-2026-03-20 (watch logs).
- DB migration: run migration script migration_20260320_v2.sql against staging copy first. Migration is backwards-compatible but long locks on users.sessions table for 10s — warn product.
- Canary config: deploy with feature flag rollout 10% (use ff-service release-2026-03-20).
- Autoscale knobs: temp min-replicas +20% for 30m post-rollout to absorb traffic spike.

During cutover (live notes)
- 09:00 UTC started pipeline. CI concurrent jobs: 34 -> watch CPU.
- 09:12 UTC found flaky test suite.integration.test_kv_cache (flaky on ci-runner-12). Marked to skip for this run (ticket created: JIRA-TEST-212).
- 09:28 UTC build passed, preparing DB migration.
- 10:00 UTC began migration window — migration script ran, took ~9s lock on sessions but no errors.
- 10:05 UTC canary deployed to eu-west-1 -> 12% traffic (ff misconfig). Need to reduce to 10% and reapply.
- 10:08 UTC fixed FF config, canary now at 10%. Health: 200/200 checks passing after 120s.

Post-canary (decisions)
- Canary healthy after 5m with no errors. Proceed to 50% at 10:20 UTC.
- Rollout to 100% scheduled at 10:40 if metrics stable (error rate < 0.5% and p95 latency within +20% of baseline).

Post-rollout validation (11:30 UTC)
- Smoke tests: quick smoke suite passed (basic generation, embeddings, streaming).
- Sanity checks: token cost metrics within expected bounds, no sudden cache eviction spikes.
- Manual checks: tried typical app flow (compose -> call API -> stream) ok.
- TODO: run full integration suite overnight and monitor alerts.

Backports / unresolved items
- PR #1349 needs backport to 2026.02.x for critical fix (affects Dedicated customers). Assign to Marcus.
- Need to follow up on quantization-compatibility test failures surfaced in staging earlier — low priority for now but create ticket.

Comms (who to notify)
- Post in #release-comm with summary + link to rollout dashboard (include release tag + time).
- Email cs-alerts@redwood.com for any Dedicated customers with special configs.
- Notify a few customers who had early access to the feature (see linked spreadsheet in Confluence) — Aisha owns outreach.

Rollback plan (if things go sideways)
- Criteria: error rate > 1% sustained for > 5m OR p95 latency > 2x baseline OR data-loss incident.
- Rollback steps: revert release tag -> trigger pipeline to deploy release/v2026.03.19 (verified stable).
- DB: if migration is not backportable, follow DB rollback doc (CONFLUENCE-RELEASE-DB-ROLLBACK).
- Post-rollback: open incident in PagerDuty, notify execs + customers.

Quick links (to keep handy)
- Release dashboard: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-03-20
- CI pipeline: https://ci.redwood/repo/pipelines/release-2026-03-20
- Rollout/traffic dashboard: https://telemetry.redwood/dashboards/rollout-2026-03-20
- Runbooks: CONFLUENCE-RELEASE-DB-ROLLBACK, CONFLUENCE-ALERTS-API-ERRORS
- PRs: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1357 (prod change), https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1349 (backport)

Notes to self / scratch items
- Remember to add postmortem template link in release notes if any incidents.
- Add a short blurb in product changelog about migration behaviour (sessions table lock detail).
- Check with infra if we can extend cache TTL for 2 hours to reduce cold-start penalty.
- Follow up on flaky test root cause next week (ci-runner-12 flaky behavior).

Open questions (left unresolved)
- Did security review sign-off arrive for the new telemetry fields? I saw an email but no Confluence note. Follow up with security (Marcus).
- Confirm whether Dedicated customers have the new KMS rotation toggle on by default — affects migration path.

End-of-day quick log
- 18:00 local: ensure all monitoring checks back to normal. Add final note to Confluence release page (I will draft the short summary).

— Zoe
